full.description: Escape hatch: return every comment in resolved threads verbatim. By default the complete-thread reads (default list, --recent, --thread without --tail) are folded — a resolved thread collapses to its root + conclusion, with the dropped count reported on the root — so you do not pay tokens for settled discussion. recent.description: Return the N most recently active threads. since.description: Only return comments created after this timestamp (RFC3339)

tail.description: Only valid with --thread. Cap reply count to the N most recent replies; the thread root is always included (even with --tail 0). Use --before/--before-id to scroll to older replies.
